responsibility: Shared architecture-specific assembly include fragment used by GNAT’s VxWorks signal-trampoline implementation. It defines the macro machinery, DWARF CFI register mappings, unwind directives, and per-architecture stub bodies for PowerPC, ARM/AArch64, i386, and x86-64 that are inserted into the VxWorks trampoline sources so __gnat_sigtramp can present a recoverable signal frame to GCC’s unwinder. Its role is not to choose VxWorks ucontext layouts—that is done in sigtramp-vxworks.c—but to generate the low-level asm/CFI sequences that save the right context register as the CFA basis, describe saved registers, and call the real signal handler in a way traceback and exception propagation can unwind through.
